title: fix(plugin-grid): the summary footer reads `currency` / `defaultCurrency` / `precision` / `scale` from the object field only; the column-level read is retired (objectui#11588)
body:
Fixes #11588

Clause-②: no

Retire, not widen (triage ruling `5975948055`). The `object-grid` summary footer now reads `currency`, `defaultCurrency`, `precision` and `scale` from the object field (`fieldMetadata`) only. This is how the same object already read `currencyConfig` (objectui#10354) and `max` (objectui#11475). `ListColumnSchema` is strict and declares none of the four keys, so a list view that authors one on a column is refused with `unrecognized_keys`. The footer honoured the key anyway, and the column's value won over the field's. Session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`, branch `claude/issue-11588-summary-hints-field-only`.

**Why `Clause-②: no`.** The exported `useColumnSummary` signature does not change: the `columns: ListColumn[]` parameter, the `fieldMetadata` parameter type and the return type are all as before. The exported `ColumnSummarySetting` / `ColumnSummaryType` / `ColumnSummaryResult` types are untouched. The diff to `useColumnSummary.ts` is the hook body plus one JSDoc paragraph. No published schema or accept set moves.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts`, the `columnHints` build inside `useColumnSummary`:
  - `currency`, `defaultCurrency`, `precision` and `scale` were `(col as any).KEY ?? meta?.KEY`. Each one is now `meta?.KEY`.
  - `type` stays a column read, because `type` is a declared `ListColumn` member. It is now read as `col.type`, without a cast. The loop variable is already typed `ListColumn`, so this site no longer holds any cast read, and an undeclared column read here no longer compiles (proved below).
  - The `currencyConfig` and `max` comments carried the "FIELD only, a column-level read would be a second, undeclared spelling" rationale. That rationale is now one comment, extended to all six keys. It is not a second copy.
  - The `@param columns` doc names what the hook reads off a column: `field`, `summary` and the declared `type`.
- New pin `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/useColumnSummary.fieldOnlyHints-11588.test.tsx`. It covers the ruling's two halves:
  - Through the hook, a column carrying `currency`, `defaultCurrency`, `scale` (number and percent) or `precision` does not change the footer.
  - Field-level `currency`, `defaultCurrency` and `scale` still decide the footer. A column's declared `type` still formats a field the hook has no def for.
  - Through `ObjectGrid`, the real caller, columns carrying all four keys render the footer the field decides. A control renders the same columns without the keys and gets the same footer.
- Seven existing pins authored the hint on the column. Each one's hint moved onto `fieldMetadata`, and its assertion is unchanged (list below).
- `packages/plugin-grid/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` (Column Summaries) now say the footer's formatting hints come from the object field only. The README's percent-width paragraph now says "the field's" `scale` / `precision`, not "the column's".
- `.changeset/11588-summary-hints-field-only.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch. It follows the wording of objectui#11544's changeset (PR objectui#11563).

## Pins moved (the hint moved onto the field, the assertion kept)

- `src/useColumnSummary.test.tsx`
  - "still prefers an explicit column currency over the tenant default" is renamed to "… explicit field currency …".
  - In the `precision` / `scale` currency cases and the three numeric-family cases, `currency` / `precision` / `scale` move to `fieldMetadata`.
- `__tests__/useColumnSummary.currencyMinorUnit-10221.test.tsx`: the `footer` helper hands the def to the hook as `fieldMetadata` and keeps only `field` on the column. Every call site and assertion is unchanged.
- `__tests__/useColumnSummary.numberWidth-9843.test.tsx`: the same change to the `footer` helper. The parameter is renamed from `column` to `fieldDef`.
- `__tests__/useColumnSummary.percentConvergence-9269.test.tsx`: "still honours the width declared by the column scale" is renamed to "… by the field scale". The `scale: 2` moves to `fieldMetadata`.
- `__tests__/useColumnSummary.percentScale-9295.test.tsx`: the `summaryLabel` helper puts the `precision` / `scale` hints on the field. Call sites and assertions are unchanged.
- `__tests__/useColumnSummary.tenantLocale-9294.test.tsx`: the three currency arms gain a `fieldDef` that carries `currency` / `scale`. The helper hands it over as `fieldMetadata`.
- `__tests__/percentAbsentScale.fiveFaces-9843.test.tsx`: the footer face receives the same field def as the other faces, through `fieldMetadata`. Before, the def was spread onto the column.

No pin was deleted. The PM named two more files: `useColumnSummary.currencyMode-10422` and `gridFixedCurrency-10354`. Both author `currencyConfig` on the FIELD and needed no move.

## Premise, measured on `origin/main` `bdc9049`

- `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 `ListColumnSchema` has fourteen keys: field, label, width, align, hidden, sortable, resizable, wrap, type, pinned, summary, prefix, link, action. `safeParse({ field, precision: 4 })` answers `unrecognized_keys` naming `precision`. `type` is a declared optional string.
- There is one read site: a repo grep for a cast column read of the four keys finds only the `columnHints` build. The list cell's `fieldMeta` bag in `ObjectGrid.tsx` already takes `currency` / `precision` / `scale` off the object field def. After this change the footer and the cell read the same source.
- In-repo producers: none. `summary: 'sum'` or `'avg'` appears zero times in `examples/**` and `apps/**` outside tests. Control: the same pattern hits `content/docs`, `packages/plugin-grid/README.md` and several plugin-grid tests. No docs page authors one of the four keys beside `summary`.
- **PM hypothesis 1 (reproduce first) holds for three keys, and is falsified for `precision`.** On the base tree the new pin gave `Tests 5 failed | 6 passed (11)`, which matches the direction table written in its header:
  - column `currency`: expected `Sum: $1,234.50`, got `Sum: €1,234.50`. Column `defaultCurrency`: the same.
  - column `scale: 4` over a field `scale: 2`: `Sum: 1.5000`. Column `scale: 3` over a percent field `scale: 1`: `Sum: 25.000%`.
  - through `ObjectGrid`: `Deal Amount: Sum: €1,234.50`.
  - The `precision` case was green on base. No arm of `formatSummaryLabel` reads `precision`: the currency arm takes the ISO 4217 minor unit (objectui#10221), and the percent and number arms take `scale` through `resolveFieldScale` (objectui#9295, objectui#9843). So the brief's `precision: 4` over `precision: 2` example cannot go red. Its case stays in the pin so that all four ruled keys are covered, and the header says it is green on both trees.
- **Hypothesis 4 (narrow the column side):** there was nothing to narrow. The column side is already `ListColumn`, and the reads were casts. The `column` parameter of `formatSummaryLabel` is the merged hints bag, and it still carries all these members, now from the field. `fieldMetadata` is the field side. Neither changed.

## Tests (HEAD `289456b`)

- Whole package: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/` gives `Test Files 185 passed (185)` and `Tests 1711 passed (1711)`. This run came after the final commit.
- The same run with the fix in place but before the pins moved gave `Tests 48 failed | 1663 passed (1711)`, in exactly the seven files listed above.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. `--listFiles` on `tsconfig.test.json` lists each of the nine touched sources once.
- Dependency closure: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build` exits 0, with 14 of 47 projects in scope.
- Doc-reading tests that name the edited docs: `scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` and `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-readme-examples-9522.test.ts` give `Test Files 3 passed (3)` and `Tests 163 passed (163)`.

## Ablation (one-shot, from the committed fix, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode)

- **Behaviour.** The anchor `currency: meta?.currency,` was replaced with `currency: (col as any).currency ?? meta?.currency,`. The anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the blob from `77bd9172fad6` to `c5f3c64e2751`.
  - Predicted: the two `currency` cases go red and everything else stays green.
  - Observed: `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)`. The failures were "column `currency` …" (`expected 'Sum: €1,234.50' to be 'Sum: $1,234.50'`) and the `ObjectGrid` case (`Deal Amount: Sum: €1,234.50`).
  - Restore: the blob equals HEAD (`77bd9172fad6`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Type.** The same anchor was replaced with `currency: col.currency ?? meta?.currency,`. `tsc --noEmit` gives `error TS2339: Property 'currency' does not exist on type` (the `ListColumn` object shape). Restore: the blob equals HEAD.
- The pin imports `../useColumnSummary` relatively, so the subject resolves to `src/`, not to a `dist/`. No dist preflight applies.

## Gates (HEAD `289456b`, each exit 0)

- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `check-control-bytes: OK`.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `9 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` and `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`: OK.
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: `No test source names a pending changeset`.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` is report-only. It names three pending changesets:
  - `6650-listcolumn-wrap-implemented` is about `wrap` and does not apply.
  - `9269-grid-summary-percent-converged` and `grid-summary-footer-tenant-locale-9294` say the percent and currency arms read "the column's `scale`". That was written when the hints bag was `col ?? field`. They are left as written: they are records of their own change, and `check-changeset-overwrite` refuses edits to a pending changeset. This PR's changeset states the field-only rule.
- `pnpm check:handler-key-reads`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers` and `node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`: OK.
- For the docs edits, these report OK: `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`, `check:doc-types`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:shell-escape-residue` and `node scripts/check-doc-expression-carriage.mjs`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the changed paths answers "An ordinary pull request".

## Narrowings (declared)

- **Lint (CI-owned).** This was a narrowed run over the nine changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files.
  - The population comes from eslint's own config: `eslint --print-config` resolves all nine, so none is ignored.
  - `--format json` counts 9 files.
  - `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
  - Result: 0 errors and 18 warnings, the same in both inline-config and `--no-inline-config` forms. All 18 are `no-explicit-any`: 17 in test helpers and 1 on the hook's `data` parameter.
  - The same eight pre-existing files at BASE give 0 errors and 23 warnings. `useColumnSummary.ts` drops from 6 to 1, because the five `(col as any)` reads are gone.
- The full sharded `pnpm test`, the build-reading gates (`check:published-dist`, `check:node-esm-load`, `check:readme-exports` and the rest) and the docs build belong to CI. This diff adds no import, export or dependency. The README edit is prose and adds no export name.
- Downstream consumers of `@object-ui/plugin-grid` were not re-tested, because the public surface is unchanged (see `Clause-②`). A repo-wide grep finds no test outside `packages/plugin-grid` that authors one of the four keys on a grid column. That grep covered every test file that carries both a `summary:` literal and one of the hint words, and the only hits outside `plugin-grid` were `fields` and `plugin-timeline` tests that do not mount a grid footer.

## Acceptance notes

- `precision` is carried in the hints bag (from the field) but no arm of `formatSummaryLabel` reads it. The ruling says to read it from the field, so it stays a field read. Dropping it is a separate question, and no carrier is named for it.
- The field-side `currency` / `defaultCurrency` are not `FieldSchema` keys either. The spec refuses `currency` by name, and `resolveFieldCurrency` documents `defaultCurrency` as a legacy spelling it keeps on purpose. The ruling keeps these field reads, so this PR does not touch them.
- `columnReadBoundary-6458` bounds undeclared column reads by source scan, but only in `ObjectGrid.tsx`. This site is now held by its type (no cast) plus the behaviour pin. A cast read added back would compile, and only the pin would catch it, for the three keys that change output. Extending the scan was not done here, and no carrier is named.
